referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A deep green navigation sits over a large garden photograph, with the promise and actions held on the right side of the opening. The next chapter uses a centered editorial about block, followed by a six-card service grid, a four-person team row, a full-width contact form over imagery, testimonial cards and a dark green footer. The visual language is calm and botanical: white and pale surfaces, saturated green actions, simple line icons and generous photographic proof. Demo people, project imagery, phone numbers and claims are source-only and must not be presented as client facts.

heroGeometry.alignment: garden image with the promise and actions on the right side of the opening
heroGeometry.viewport: promise, supporting line and primary contact action remain visible in the opening desktop viewport

navigationGeometry.mode: deep green wordmark and direct service navigation
navigationGeometry.placement: compact top bar over the opening image
navigationGeometry.mobile: wordmark and menu control remain visible; navigation stacks without covering the promise

typography.display: large clean sans heading with a calm local-service voice
typography.scale: compact opening statement, clear section labels and readable service metadata

palette.contrastIntent: dark green actions on light surfaces with legible body copy

imageTreatment.mode: split garden photography with contained service imagery
imageTreatment.crop: split opening image; contained service and team images
imageTreatment.focalPoint: gardens and planting detail; source people are never client staff

servicePresentation.pattern: service grid followed by a clear contact close
servicePresentation.interaction: static service grid; navigation and contact action remain usable without motion

ctaPlacement.primary: contact action in the opening and contact close

motion.primitive: native menu, hover and image reveal
motion.library: static HTML/CSS in the source; no runtime dependency is required
motion.reducedMotion: all services, contact details and imagery remain visible without transitions

mobileRecomposition.strategy: stack the split opening, service offerings and enquiry form while keeping the primary action visible
rules: keep the promise and contact action before long service detail
collapse the navigation into a readable menu
stack service cards without horizontal page overflow
preserve image crops inside their containers

prohibitedPatterns: copying source branding, copy, demo people, phone numbers, prices, reviews or project claims
presenting template people or garden photography as client staff, customers or completed work
inventing licenses, guarantees, service windows or coverage
using a generic identical card wall for every chapter

requiredSignatureElements.description: a garden photograph shares the opening with the promise and actions
services are presented as a clear grid with concise factual descriptions
approved team or owner imagery is shown as a readable row, never as stock clients

acceptanceChecks: the split opening and primary action are visible at desktop and mobile widths
the service grid follows the opening and is grounded in client services
template people are never presented as client staff or customers
the contact action is real and uses only approved client details
the rendered page has no horizontal overflow at 390px and 320px
